# EVMint — Multi-Chain EVM Token Launcher
# https://evmint.io

> EVMint is a no-code platform for creating and deploying ERC-20 tokens on 15+ EVM blockchains. Users connect a wallet, fill in token details (name, symbol, supply), and deploy in under 60 seconds. Contracts are automatically verified on block explorers. Liquidity can be added via integrated DEXes (Uniswap V2, PancakeSwap, QuickSwap, SushiSwap, TraderJoe, SpookySwap).

## Pricing

| Deployment | ~$80 equivalent in native token (any chain) |
| Gas fees | Varies: < $0.01 on L2s, $1-5 on Ethereum |
| Subscription | None |

## How It Works

1. Connect your Web3 wallet (MetaMask, Coinbase Wallet, WalletConnect, or Privy embedded wallet)
2. Choose a blockchain network from 15+ supported chains
3. Enter token name, symbol, and total supply
4. Click "Create Token" — one transaction deploys and verifies the contract
5. Optionally add liquidity on the chain's DEX

## Supported Chains

Ethereum (1), Base (8453), Arbitrum (42161), Optimism (10), Robinhood Chain (4663), MegaETH (4326), BSC (56), Polygon (137), Avalanche (43114), Monad (143), Fantom (250), Gnosis (100), Moonbeam (1284), World Chain (480), Blast (81457)

## Key Features

- No coding or Solidity knowledge required
- OpenZeppelin-audited smart contract templates
- Automatic source code verification on Etherscan, Basescan, Arbiscan, Blockscout, etc.
- Built-in liquidity management (add/remove) via Uniswap V2 and compatible DEXes
- 100% non-custodial — deployer owns the token contract
- Works on desktop and mobile

## Common Questions

Q: How much does it cost to create a token?
A: ~$80 equivalent in the chain's native token, plus minimal gas fees. Same price on all 15+ chains.

Q: Do I need to know how to code?
A: No. EVMint handles all smart contract code. You fill in a form with your token name, symbol, and supply.

Q: Is the contract audited?
A: Yes. The ERC20 implementation extends OpenZeppelin's battle-tested contracts, audited by multiple firms.

Q: Can I add liquidity after creating my token?
A: Yes. EVMint has built-in liquidity management via Uniswap V2 and compatible DEXes.

Q: Who owns the token contract?
A: You do. EVMint is non-custodial. No admin keys, upgrade proxies, or pause functions.

Q: Can I create a meme coin?
A: Yes. Meme coins are standard ERC-20 tokens. Set your name, symbol, and supply (most use 1 billion).

Q: Which chain should I choose?
A: Base and Arbitrum have the lowest fees and strong DEX liquidity. Ethereum has highest credibility but higher gas.

Q: Can I deploy on testnet first?
A: Yes. Switch to a testnet in your wallet. Testnet deployments use faucet tokens and cost nothing.

Q: What wallets are supported?
A: MetaMask, Coinbase Wallet, Rainbow, WalletConnect-compatible wallets, and Privy embedded wallets.

Q: Is there a token limit?
A: No. You can create unlimited tokens across any supported chain.
